MitSailingHome.meta_description: Sailing programs, events, and fleet at the MIT Sailing Pavilion.

MitSailingHome.hero_body: One of the finest university sailing programs in the world — open to MIT students, faculty, staff, and the public.
MitSailingHome.hero_image_alt: MIT Sailing boats on the Charles River with the Boston skyline
MitSailingHome.hours_sun_box: Sunset times and daily open hours follow the table. Team practices run on a separate schedule.
MitSailingHome.how_to_title: How to get on the water
MitSailingHome.how_to_1_desc: Free for MIT students. Alumni and public need an MIT Rec membership.
MitSailingHome.how_to_2_desc: Sign up for Learn to Sail or Intro for Experienced Sailors.
MitSailingHome.how_to_3_desc: Pass your skills test, receive your rating, and book boats anytime.

MitSailingHome.fleet_subtitle: From stable training dinghies to high-performance racing shells.
MitSailingHome.classes_subtitle: Every sailor starts with a required beginner class. Once you have your first rating, choose from a range of advanced courses.
MitSailingHome.classes_start_label: Start here — required for all new sailors
MitSailingHome.membership_subtitle: MIT Sailing is open to the entire MIT community and the general public.
MitSailingHome.membership_foot: Full membership details and MIT Fitness info available from the pavilion.

MitSailingHome.rental_title: Host Your Event at the Pavilion
MitSailingHome.rental_body: The MIT Sailing Pavilion offers a stunning waterfront venue on the Charles River — available for MIT events, private celebrations, weddings, corporate functions, and more.
MitSailingHome.rental_bullet_1: Waterfront deck with Boston skyline views
MitSailingHome.rental_bullet_2: Capacity for private and large group events
MitSailingHome.rental_bullet_3: Available to MIT community and general public
MitSailingHome.rental_bullet_4: Weddings, receptions, corporate functions, and more
